_about: The living list of everything Leyline is made of, one piece per entry, and where its mods lists live (docs/BLANK-SLATE.md). Machine-readable: tools/commons/commons.py check-directory checks it, and commons.py wiki prints it as the forum's pinned directory post. 'alone' is how far the piece runs without the rest: today, later (needs work first) or plan (designed, not built). 'public' is true when the code is already in the public Leyline repo (tools/leyline-repo/export.py ALLOW).

capabilities.name: Launcher
capabilities.what: The desktop app: log in, add your own game folders, mods, Official and Community realms, Your Den, hosting, self-update.
needs: a website for log in and the realm list (optional: it still plays solo, Den and mesh realms)
capabilities.run_alone: cd launcher && npm ci && npx tauri build (rebrand first: launcher/scripts/rebrand.py)

capabilities.name: Launcher releases and self-update
capabilities.what: Builds and signs each release; launchers update from GitHub, then mirrors, never installing anything an updater key did not sign.
capabilities.run_alone: npx tauri build with TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY set; upload the files and latest.json anywhere static

capabilities.name: Release mirror
capabilities.what: Copies releases, the Host pack, addons and pinned server source to a static folder with sha256 and torrents.
capabilities.run_alone: python3 -I tools/release-mirror/release_mirror.py build --out DIR

capabilities.name: Release log (the chain)
capabilities.what: A signed, hash-linked list of every release, so anyone can check the files they have.
capabilities.run_alone: PYTHONPATH=hosting/kit/tools python3 -m wunet.releaselog keygen|append|verify

capabilities.name: Mod index and daily updater
capabilities.what: Finds open mods every day, checks each (licence, no game files, no paid, no decompiled code) and writes a link-out catalog. A person approves.
needs: network access to the code forges
capabilities.run_alone: python3 -I tools/hub-index/hub_index.py build; python3 -I tools/addon-curate/curate.py run

capabilities.name: Log in page and Hero Key (website side)
capabilities.what: The /wrath/key Log in page: Hero Key file or paste, Google, Create a Hero Key; signed realm passes.
needs: the sign-in service (a separate project, not in this repo)
the key table, pepper and site key for the same players' keys
capabilities.run_alone: inside the website (stream/wrath_portal.py); without the sign-in service it shows 'Log in isn't answering'

capabilities.name: Hero Key for realms (checking side)
capabilities.what: A community realm checks a site-signed pass and makes the player's account. Off by default.
capabilities.run_alone: setup.py herokey on|off|pin

capabilities.name: Relay and mesh node
capabilities.what: Lets home realms be reached with no open ports and the host's address hidden; gossips the realm list and release log.
capabilities.run_alone: tools/commons/Be a node.bat, or setup.py volunteer-relay --host NAME then docker compose -f docker-compose.volunteer-relay.yml up -d

capabilities.name: Host kit and Host pack
capabilities.what: One click to host a realm: builds the server from its authors' source, reads map data from your own client on your own PC.
capabilities.licence: MIT (realm images: AGPL-3.0 AzerothCore; other profiles GPL-2.0)
capabilities.run_alone: tools/commons/Start my own server.bat, or Host a Leyline realm.bat, or bash leyline host

capabilities.name: Den Lite
capabilities.what: A tiny local server for one player's private building world (Your Den). No Docker, no database.
capabilities.run_alone: cargo build --release, then den-lite --dens FOLDER --bind 127.0.0.1

capabilities.name: Forge
capabilities.what: The Den's ground editor (Windows), from Noggit Red.
capabilities.run_alone: the forge.yml CI build (release forge-latest, with its source tarball)

capabilities.name: Website, portal and hub
capabilities.what: The front page, realm list, profiles, social, Workshop, flags file, HQ. One Python program behind any web server.
needs: the sign-in service for Log in
capabilities.run_alone: tools/commons 'Make my own Leyline' packs site/ with run-site.sh and portal.env

capabilities.name: Forum
capabilities.what: The built-in forum: plain text and links, one SQLite file, moderated from HQ.
capabilities.run_alone: inside the website only

capabilities.name: Browser kit (play in the browser with your own files)
capabilities.what: The game page around the browser client: reads the player's own game folder in the tab, never uploads it.
needs: the browser client build (wenilla.js and its wasm: built from a separate source, not in this repo)
a realm that lets browser players in
capabilities.run_alone: tools/commons 'Make my own Leyline' packs browser-kit/ (own files only, no slices)

capabilities.name: Leyline in-game addons
capabilities.what: The in-game Leyline window, Host window and their art (our own files).
capabilities.licence: MIT (ours); listed addons keep their own
capabilities.run_alone: copy into the client's Interface/AddOns, or the launcher installs them

capabilities.name: Leyline Control
capabilities.what: The owner's local panel: runs named steps from a queue, with logs and Autopilot.
capabilities.run_alone: py -3 tools\control\control.py (every step is also a plain .bat)

capabilities.name: Agents (MCP) and the community brain
capabilities.what: A local MCP server for the player's own assistant, with read, ask and never tiers; the building library and guides.
capabilities.run_alone: Leyline mcp

capabilities.name: Fork kit
capabilities.what: One branding.json for the launcher, rebrand.py to apply it, fork_kit.py to check a copy is ready on its own.
capabilities.run_alone: python3 -I tools/fork-kit/fork_kit.py check

capabilities.name: Make my own Leyline (the commons kit)
capabilities.what: A few questions, then a skinned site, Log in page, browser kit, host kit and launcher branding, ready to upload.
capabilities.run_alone: tools/commons/Make my own Leyline.bat, or python3 -I tools/commons/commons.py make

capabilities.name: Discord bridge
capabilities.what: Carries a realm's World chat to and from one Discord channel, plus a bug feed.
needs: a Discord server and bot of your own
capabilities.run_alone: PYTHONPATH=hosting/discord python3 -m wudiscord.bridge --check

capabilities.name: Discord server setup
capabilities.what: Lays out a Discord server's channels and roles once, after a preview and a typed YES.
capabilities.run_alone: Leyline Discord - preview.bat, then Leyline Discord - do it.bat (tools/discord-leyline/README.md)

capabilities.name: Azeroth Survivors (mode)
capabilities.what: A browser mode, an unmodified open rebuild pinned by commit.
capabilities.licence: upstream MIT or Apache-2.0; permission statement TODO(owner)
needs: the upstream build at its pinned commit
capabilities.run_alone: a local launcher mode is planned, not built

capabilities.name: Fresh computer test
capabilities.what: Every feature from an empty profile, PASS or FAIL per check.
capabilities.run_alone: tools/first-run/Fresh computer test.bat

capabilities.name: Seeded realm (one host at a time, never one place)
capabilities.what: A realm that players carry: one elected host, Keepers holding a copy, a signed lease at the relay.
capabilities.run_alone: designed, not built (Seed v0)

capabilities.name: Kill switch
capabilities.what: Turns parts of the official network off cleanly; built separately (docs/KILL-SWITCH.md).
capabilities.run_alone: see docs/KILL-SWITCH.md

mod_directories.name: Community mod index
mod_directories.what: Every open project the index found, link-out only, with its checks. Nothing hosted.

mod_directories.name: Approved one-click addons
mod_directories.what: Addons pinned to an exact file and sha256 for the launcher's one-click install, after a person approved them.

mod_directories.name: Looks and HD packs
mod_directories.what: Graphics looks; found ones stay pending until approved.

mod_directories.name: Game modes
mod_directories.what: The modes the launcher builds in.

mod_directories.name: Realm templates
mod_directories.what: The realm templates the Host page offers.
